messages:
sara: FYI support ticket #3421 — customer (acme-ai) reports p99 spikes on /v1/generate during peak. Sharing traces and a small repro. timeline: spikes started ~09:10 UTC.
perf-alert-bot: alert: p99 latency > 500ms for model redwood-small across region us-west-2 (30m window).
mike: I instrumented the prefix-cache metrics — cache_miss_rate jumped from ~3% -> ~42% and unique_keys/min up ~20x. Logs show keys with session ids and user metadata appended.
angela: Could be cache key entropy. Any recent deploys touching prefix-cache keying?
ryan: No keying deploys today. Traffic pattern change seems likely — maybe customers started sending long random convo/session ids in prompts.
leila: Pulled a sample of keys from logs: `pref:ctx:user|conv=3f8a1c9b...|len=128|meta=xyz`. Lots of trailing hashes and ephemeral fields. We should normalize and drop volatile fields.
sara: Support needs mitigation ASAP — p99 is impacting SLAs. Short-term fixes?
mike: Short term: increase cache capacity on us-west-2 pool by +25% and switch eviction from per-shard LRU -> global LFU for prefix cache. Also add a 10m TTL for keys with high cardinality.
ops-bot: autoscaler: increased prefix-cache pool capacity in us-west-2 by 25% (actioned).
angela: I'll prototype key-normalization: lowercase, strip session/conversation ids, keep model+prompt-prefix+config. Patch ready for canary.
mike: Repro (example):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n -d '{"model":"redwood-small","prompt":"user: hi
meta:session=3f8a1c9b...
assistant:"}'
```
You'll see generated cache key: `pref:mdl=redwood-small|prompt=user: hi|meta:session=3f8a1c9b` -> unique per session.
ryan: We also need a cardinality histogram + top-keys gauge so we can detect heavy tails quickly.
leila: I'll run a backfill job to prefill cache with top 500 prefixes from the last 24h, should reduce cold miss storms. ETA ~20m.
sara: Can we canary the normalization today? Support will tell the customer we have a remediation plan.
angela: Deploying canary (10% traffic) to us-west-2 with normalize_keys=true (strip session_id & conversation_id). Watching p95/p99 and cache_miss_rate.
ops-bot: canary deployed to 10% traffic. Auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.5% or error_rate spike.
mike: Canary metrics: p99 dropped from ~560ms -> ~190ms, miss_rate from 42% -> 8% on canary nodes. Promising.
sara: I'll update support ticket #3421 with the mitigation plan and ETA.
angela: Creating a follow-up runtime backlog card: add key-normalization config + automated warmup. Assigning @leila and @mike.
ryan: Add a load-qa test that fuzzes session ids to ensure cache key cardinality stays bounded.
leila: Starting prefill job now. Will post results.
perf-alert-bot: alert cleared — p99 back within SLO in us-west-2.
sara: Great. Next steps: if customer saw >5% SLA breach open a postmortem, otherwise write a short runbook entry for cache thrash + mitigation steps.
mike: I'll push the normalization hotfix to prod after a 30m monitoring window.
angela: Config snippet being deployed in canary:
```yaml
prefix_cache:
  normalize_keys: true
  strip_fields: ['session_id','conversation_id']
  global_eviction: 'lfu'
  ttl_seconds: 600
```
sara: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll update ticket #3421 with timeline and PR links.
leila: Prefill job done — added ~420 hot prefixes to cache, initial hit-rate on those keys is ~75%.
mike: Rolling normalization to 50% now, watching.
ops-bot: scheduled rollback point at +60m if error or p99 regressions.
angela: After 2h monitoring window, will cut to full rollout if stable.
sara: Documenting runbook steps: detect high unique_keys/min -> check key patterns -> normalize -> warmup -> increase capacity if needed.
perf-alert-bot: note: added new metric `prefix_cache.key_cardinality` and `prefix_cache.top_keys` to infra dashboard.
sara: Solid work team. I'll send a short summary to support and flag for a postmortem only if customer SLA impact confirmed. :tada:
